distinct_task_definition: one admitted task id bound to one public contract and one source commit; repetitions of that task are not additional distinct tasks

mechanical_expansion_rule.expression: for any stratum s, expand while verified_distinct_tasks(s) < preregistered_required_distinct_tasks(s)
mechanical_expansion_rule.selection_order: admit eligible tasks in ascending (repository_url, source_commit, task_id) order from the preregistered candidate list
mechanical_expansion_rule.replacement_rule: before primary outcomes, replace an unusable task with the next eligible task in the same stratum; after primary outcomes, do not add, substitute, or relabel tasks

freeze_condition.expression: freeze iff every preregistration field is immutable and, for every stratum s, verified_distinct_tasks(s) >= preregistered_required_distinct_tasks(s), and every admitted task satisfies every admission filter
freeze_condition.required_output: a study manifest that records the power rationale, the frozen registry SHA-256, and the exact admitted task ids
